versions.content: Semantics of CryptoServiceKey Meta-class CryptoSer- viceKey allows for the description of the applicable cryptographic key. The ability to aggregate a ValueSpecification in the role developmentValue shall be used to distribute development keys to suppliers such that crypto functionality can be ade- quately verified during development.
